state.purpose: Resolve the suspected ordering gap in tenant RBAC bootstrap, separating runtime correctness from whether the definitive target is explicit enough.
state.sourceExcerpt: TenantRbacBootstrapReactor builds commands in this order: DefineRole(admin); DefineTeam(administrators); if ownerBecomesAdministrator, RegisterMember(owner); AssignTeamRole(administrators, adminRole); AssignPermission(TenantAccess); AssignPermission(TenantRbacManage); AssignPermission(ProgramManage); if ownerBecomesAdministrator, AssignTeamMember(administrators, ownerMember). The handler awaits commands serially. Assignment failure throws and prevents reactor checkpoint completion. Replayed role/team definition conflicts are tolerated; other effects retry identical source-derived identities.

selectedRows.proofGate: Use canonical built-in IDs and source-derived relationship command IDs. Register owner only when selected as first administrator; bind its registration episode. Administrative role link and core permissions precede activation-triggering assignment; guarded admin assignment retains its source-admission process.
selectedRows.recoveryContract: Replayed bootstrap allows existing role/team-definition conflicts as explicitly coded; other effects retry identical deterministic identities. Never manufacture a missing permission or membership result.

flow.instructions: Which conclusion best fits this bootstrap flow and its approved target rows?

criteria.runtime_and_target_sound: The separate owner commands preserve authority; serial order makes TeamRole and all required admin permissions durable before the activation-triggering TeamMember assignment, and assignment occurs only when the owner is an administrator.
criteria.runtime_sound_target_under_specified: The described runtime order is sound, but the target rows/physical plan do not explicitly encode the required command ordering and ownerBecomesAdministrator conditional, so target conformance is not decidable from the catalog alone.
criteria.runtime_flow_defect: Even with the supplied serial order, the flow can activate before prerequisites, violate an owner invariant, or lose retry/recovery correctness.
criteria.evidence_insufficient: The excerpt does not establish whether the target and runtime preserve the required authorization and activation semantics.

target_order_explicit.instructions: Do the selected S012-S016 choreography rows explicitly encode the exact ordering and conditional branch needed for tenant activation safety?

criteria.true: The target states dependencies that require role definition/link and all admin permissions before TeamMember assignment, and states the assignment condition.
criteria.false: The target only contains shared prose or edge membership and leaves the exact sequence/conditional assignment implicit.

sequence_sufficient.instructions: Is the supplied serial runtime order sufficient to ensure the first administrator assignment cannot trigger activation before its required role link and core permissions are committed?

criteria.true: Each prior command completes durably before the awaited assignment command and failure prevents successful checkpoint completion.
criteria.false: The order, durability, or failure handling permits activation before a required prerequisite.
